slides.texte_overlay:
5 ways to become you again

(stop feeling lost)

Call the people who knew
you before

Old friends remember who you were
when you forget.

Go somewhere without a plan

A new street, a new town.
Getting a little lost helps
you find yourself.

Make something with your hands

Cook, build, fix, draw.
Finishing something small
feels like you again.

Keep one promise a day

Small ones count.
Trust in yourself comes back
one promise at a time.

Feed your curiosity

Learn something new every day.
Curiosity is the part of you
that never really left.
